note: Weighted triage (contract v2). A rule with 'level' is a hard stop: it sets that care level whatever the points. A rule with 'points' adds to the score. Score at or above levels.URGENT gives URGENT, at or above levels.SOON gives SOON, otherwise ROUTINE. Every single sign on the NHS shoulder-pain urgent list is worth at least levels.SOON on its own. All points and thresholds are draft and need clinician sign-off. unresolved: a hard-stop answer still 'Not sure' after its simpler question; up to 'allowed' of them (never chest or breathing) do not stop the check and make the result at least 'level'; more, or chest or breathing, is CLARIFY (see a doctor). They add no points, so a further answer can never lower the result.
